data.body: AC amendment: This task can only be completed AFTER the integration test (8de3-8561) has been executed in CI with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set and produced actual findings output. The close artifact requires real data (finding counts, compliance percentages) from the live runner.py invocation. The sub-agent executing this task must: (1) locate the CI run output for the integration test, (2) extract the findings JSON from the CI artifacts, (3) compute compliance percentages from actual data. Do not fabricate compliance percentages — use actual values from the CI run. If CI has not run yet, this task is blocked until CI executes T2's integration test.
